idea: Count the fewest single-letter edits (replace, delete or insert) that turn one text into another. Cell (i, j) is the distance between the first i letters of one text and the first j of the other. Equal letters copy the cell up and left; otherwise take one plus the smallest of the replace, delete and insert cells. Walking back from the corner lists the edits.
useWhen: Spell checking and suggestions: how close is a typed word to a real word
Comparing sequences when every kind of edit has the same cost
avoidWhen: Only the shared letters matter (use the longest common subsequence)
Edits have different costs: the table needs a weight for each kind of edit
